description: This Java class 'ConnectionValidator' provides validation logic for different types of network connections within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It checks connection parameters, such as hostnames, acknowledgment labels, payload mappings, certificates, and addresses, ensuring they conform to the expected configuration and constraints. The class also interacts with other components for logging, SSL context creation, and criteria filtering.

classes.name: ConnectionValidator
classes.description: A final class in the Eclipse Ditto framework that validates different types of network connections according to configuration constraints and connection-specific rules. It verifies hostnames, payload mappings, certificates, acknowledgement labels, addresses, and the overall connection type, throwing exceptions upon validation failure.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ConnectionValidator instance with specified connection protocols.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementLabelsToDeclare
methods.description: Static method to determine the set of acknowledgement labels that a connection should declare, based on its sources and targets.

methods.name: resolveConnectionIdPlaceholder
methods.description: Static method to resolve placeholders in acknowledgment labels related to connection IDs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Instance method to validate a given connection, its addresses, acknowledgements, and certificates, throwing exceptions if any validation checks fail.
